name: subagent-model
description: Subagent model tiering: pass an explicit model tier chosen by task type and result verifiability instead of inheriting the parent model.
shortDescription: Choose subagent model tiers by task type and verifiability.
longDescription: Subagent Model injects the owner's model-tiering rule at session start (Claude Code only) and ships it as a consultable skill. The default harness behavior inherits the parent model for every subagent, running retrieval-grade work on the most expensive tier. The rule downgrades precisely instead of universally: mechanically verifiable work (retrieval, grep sweeps, enumeration, bulk mechanical edits) drops two or more tiers, self-contained work whose errors surface quickly drops one, and trusted-conclusion work (design decisions, review verdicts, deep debugging) keeps the parent tier. The judgment key is task type and result verifiability, not perceived difficulty — and when unsure, do not downgrade, because a trusted wrong conclusion costs more rework than the tokens saved.
defaultPrompt: Use subagent-model to pick the model tier for this subtask.
Use subagent-model to decide whether this delegation can run on a cheaper tier.
